controls.label: Visible color
controls.notes: Color-adjusted Hubble OPAL composite from 2025, with approximate visible-color calibration. North of about 41° N, where the map is not fully observed, missing observations are continued from the boundary and faded to a uniform pole; that cap is illustrative.

controls.label: Methane
controls.notes: Hubble OPAL 619 nm reflectance from 2025, in false color. North of about 57° N, where the map is not fully observed, boundary continuation supplies an illustrative cap, not measured spectral coverage.

controls.label: Near infrared
controls.notes: Hubble OPAL 845 nm reflectance from 2025, in false color. North of about 57° N, where the map is not fully observed, boundary continuation supplies an illustrative cap, not measured spectral coverage.

source.title: Computing Apparent Planetary Magnitudes for The Astronomical Almanac
source.qualification: V-band phase equations transcribed from equations 2 through 17. Distance, rotation, season, latitude, and ring terms cancel or are held fixed so each curve isolates phase-angle dependence.
